rows.Enunciato: The global coefficient/trajectory loss underweights the local accuracy required by shallow current crossings.
rows.Condizioni di falsificazione: No paired improvement in independent atomic holdouts or unchanged full-trace timing despite sufficient FIT convergence.
rows.Limiti: Development-informed, not independent confirmation.36members share data/parents. CPU recovery differs from CUDA environment; equivalence audited, not bitwise identity. ParentH8oracles are not I3oracles. Historical analogies and gradient/clipping correlations are not causal proof. Proposed test: Compare bounded full-relaxation current losses with coefficient losses on identical FIT data and architecture.
